values.note: Reclamation: 48 paved campsites, most along the water. The recreation.gov catalog lists 41 standard non-electric drive-in sites (mostly 40-45 ft, several 50-55 ft; pull-throughs 40-100 ft, the longest site 005 at 100 ft), 4 walk-in tent-only sites and 2 host sites.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250001 ('The campground is paved with 48 campsites, most are located along the water') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 250001 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Site Access), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Vault toilets, potable water, trash and recycling and a campground host during the peak summer months.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250001 ('During the peak summer months services include vault toilets, potable water, trash, recycling containers and a campground host'; amenities 'Accessible Vault Toilets', 'Drinking Water'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bureau of Reclamation-run (Canyon Ferry Field Office). Every family site is reservable on recreation.gov (6-month rolling window); 14 nights in any 30. Check-in 5 pm, check-out 4 pm; sites must be occupied each night.

booking.source: https://www.usbr.gov/gp/recreation/cfrrec.html ('campsites for Court Sheriff and Hellgate Campgrounds can be reserved at recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250001 (rules: reservationWindow 6 Months, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', maxConsecutiveStay 14; notices 'Check in time is 5pm. Check out time is 4pm.', 'Campsites must be occupied each night.') + catalog (all non-host sites reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: Bureau of Reclamation campground at the north end of Canyon Ferry Reservoir, ~30 mi east of Helena on MT-284, between the Big Belt and Elkhorn ranges; paved, with most sites along the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 (2026 rate table; fees left as recorded), no electric, reservable on recreation.gov. Added 48 sites (catalog: pull-throughs up to 100 ft), vault toilets/potable water, 6-month window and 14-night limit. Not stated: water/sewer at sites (derived 'none' left), campground season (rec.gov rate seasons only). Note trimmed of restated values.
